<!-- example-1: body_md -->
\label{ex:hemker}
Problem \eqref{steady-strong} is considered with 
$$
   \Omega = \big((-3,9)\times(-3,3)\big) \setminus 
   \{(x,y)\in{\mathbb R}^2\,;\,\,x^2+y^2 \le 1 \}\,,
$$
$\Gamma^N=((-3,9)\times\{-3\})\cup(\{9\}\times[-3,3])\cup((-3,9)\times\{3\})$,
$\Gamma^D=\partial\Omega\setminus\overline{\Gamma^N}$, $\varepsilon=10^{-4}$,
$\boldsymbol b=(1,0)^\top$, $f=0$, $g=0$, and
\begin{align*}
   u_b(-3,y) &= 0\qquad\forall\,\,y\in(-3,3)\,,\\
   u_b(x,y) &= 1\qquad\forall\,\,(x,y)\in{\mathbb R}^2\,\,\,
   \mbox{\rm with}\,\,\,x^2+y^2=1\,.
\end{align*}
<!-- end example-1 -->
<!-- example-2: body_md -->
\label{ex1}
Problem \eqref{steady-strong} is considered with $\Omega = (0,1)^2$,
$\Gamma^D=\partial\Omega$, $\Gamma^N=\emptyset$, $\varepsilon=10^{-8}$,
$\boldsymbol b=(\cos(-\pi/3),\sin(-\pi/3))^\top$, $f=0$, and
$$
u_b(x,y) = \left\{ \begin{array}{ll}
0 & \quad\mbox{for $x=1$ or $y\le0.7$,}\\
1 & \quad\mbox{else.}
\end{array}\right.
$$
<!-- end example-2 -->
<!-- example-3: body_md -->
\label{ex2}
Problem \eqref{steady-strong} is considered with $\Omega = (0,1)^2$,
$\Gamma^N=\{0\}\times(0,1)$,
$\Gamma^D=\partial\Omega\setminus\overline{\Gamma^N}$,
$\varepsilon=10^{-8}$, 
$\boldsymbol b(x,y)=(-y,x)^\top$, $f=0$, $g=0$, 
\begin{equation*}
  u_b(x,0) = 
  \begin{cases}
  x           & \mathrm{if} \;\; 0       \leq x \leq \frac13 \;, \\
  \frac13 + x & \mathrm{if} \;\; \frac13 < x < \frac23 \;, \\
  1 - x       & \mathrm{if} \;\; \frac23 \leq x \leq 1       \;, \\
  \end{cases}
  \qquad x\in[0,1]\,,
\end{equation*}
and $u_b=0$ elsewhere on $\Gamma^D$.
<!-- end example-3 -->
